description: This file defines the EdgesTableConfigResolver class, which configures and manages the table of EdgeInfo entities in the Thingsboard UI, including actions like add, delete, assign, unassign, and navigation related to edges.

classes.name: EdgesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service class that configures and manages the edges table in the UI, including actions like add, delete, assign, unassign, and navigation for EdgeInfo entities.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and configures the table settings based on route parameters and user authority.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Configures table columns based on the edge scope (tenant, customer, customer_user).

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets fetch and delete functions for entities based on scope.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Defines context menu actions for each edge entity depending on scope.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Defines bulk actions for selected edges depending on scope.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Defines header actions for adding/importing edges depending on scope.

methods.name: addEdgesToCustomer
methods.description: Opens dialog to add new edges to a customer.

methods.name: openEdge
methods.description: Navigates to the edge detail page.

methods.name: openEdgeEntitiesByType
methods.description: Navigates to related entities (assets, devices, dashboards, etc.) for an edge.

methods.name: assignToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns selected edges to a customer.

methods.name: unassignFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns an edge from its customer.

methods.name: unassignEdgesFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns multiple edges from their customer.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new edge.

methods.name: openInstructions
methods.description: Opens instructions dialog for an edge.

methods.name: onEdgeAction
methods.description: Handles specific actions triggered on an edge.
